edges.reason: fallback unconditionally refunds msg.value to the caller before any state logic
INIT branch of fallback pushes msg.sender into team_accounts
WITHDRAWAL branch of fallback pays out tokens to msg.sender
CLOSED branch of fallback sweeps tokens to the team wallet
_state() result selects which branch of the fallback executes
inState(State.INIT) modifier guards start()
only(MULTISIG_OWNER) modifier guards start()
indexOf result drives the require checks that gate registration and payout
state() indexes labels with the value returned by _state()
locked_since is read by _state() to decide INIT vs later states
block.timestamp is compared against lock constants inside _state(), making state time dependent
LOCK_RELASE_TIME constant gates the LOCKED to WITHDRAWAL transition
WITHDRAWAL_END_TIME constant gates the WITHDRAWAL to CLOSED transition
timeToUnlockDDHHMM branches on now < LOCK_RELASE_TIME, a timestamp dependency
LOCK_RELASE_TIME is the reference point for the time remaining calculation
start() assigns locked_since = now, seeding state machine timing with miner influenceable time
start() writes locked_since, transitioning the contract out of INIT
diff is derived directly from now
diff feeds the returned [dd,hh,mm] array
dd computed from now-derived diff
dd is returned by timeToUnlockDDHHMM
hh computed from now-derived diff
hh is returned by timeToUnlockDDHHMM
mm computed from now-derived diff
mm is returned by timeToUnlockDDHHMM
token instance is the target of the external balanceOf call
token.balanceOf(this) result is cached into amount_to_distribute
token.balanceOf(this) result is stored in the local balance variable
local balance is transferred out in the CLOSED sweep
amount_to_distribute is the dividend of the payout division
team_accounts.length is the divisor; a zero length causes a division by zero revert
division result is passed to token.transfer, so truncation/dust and div-by-zero affect payout correctness
amount_to_distribute determines the value transferred to the member
token instance is the target of the withdrawal transfer external call
team_accounts.length scales the per-member payout
token instance is the target of the sweep transfer external call
attacker controlled msg.sender is the recipient of the ether refund
msg.sender is the value pushed into the team_accounts array
msg.sender is the recipient of the token payout
msg.sender is required to equal TEAM_WALLET before the sweep is executed
require(msg.sender == TEAM_WALLET) is the sole authorisation for the full-balance sweep
MULTISIG_OWNER is the allowed address enforced by the only modifier
msg.sender is compared against the allowed address to grant privileged access
team_accounts array is searched by indexOf
msg.sender is the address looked up in the team_accounts array
the addrs storage parameter is the array iterated by indexOf
the addr parameter is compared against each array element
loop counter i indexes the searched array
labels array is indexed to produce the human readable state string
all_team_accounts() returns the team_accounts state array
external ether send to msg.sender invokes the recipient contract, which may call back into the payable fallback
token.transfer is an external call on an untrusted token contract and can reenter the fallback before state settles
token.transfer sweep is an external call on an untrusted token contract and can reenter the fallback
token.balanceOf is an external call into a caller-supplied token contract able to reenter the fallback
